59/S0.subgoal: Introduce the Majuli VR case study and explain why its large multimodal content requires resource optimization for real-time interactive rendering.

59/S1.subgoal: Describe how the Oculus Quest 2 deployment was optimized by storing videos in the cloud, reducing local size and computation while introducing network requirements.

59/S2.subgoal: Describe how the Majuli VR system was optimized for low-cost smartphone/cardboard deployment by compressing images and removing video, and explain why such trade-offs are generally needed for resource-constrained platforms.

59/S3.subgoal: Summarize the lecture's main points on VR resource optimization and point to further resources on computer graphics.
